issue.problem: Collapse of campus perimeter stone boundary wall
issue.severity_reason: The collapse of a boundary wall creates a significant security risk and potential safety hazard due to open access and debris.
user_reported_facts: Large section of stone boundary wall has collapsed
Area is overgrown with thorny wild bushes
Trash is present in the area
inferred_information: The site may be prone to unauthorized access due to the wall breach (uncertainty: extent of breach not specified)
The presence of thorny bushes and trash suggests the collapse may have occurred some time ago (uncertainty: exact timeline unknown)
missing_information: Specific coordinates or building reference for the wall section
Exact date or duration of the collapse
Photographic evidence to confirm the scale of the damage
issue.recommended_action: Dispatch a maintenance team to secure the perimeter with temporary fencing, clear the debris and vegetation, and initiate structural repairs to the stone wall.
